person_made_it: Yes: Foster's own words, his real tracks and site, his frog sage and his Poe Beat are the spine, not stock lore.
emcee_who_is_speaking: Darby, for Gordon, speaking to Foster about his own project; the podcast hosts are clearly a produced show, not Gordon.
what_time_of_day_is_this_room: Night at sea: the hour before the drop, indigo dark with ember light.
did_the_click_pay_me: Every glyph plays a distinct live bass sound and opens a lore card; all twelve trigger a finale; the map stars croak, ring and drop.
works_for_the_recipient: Opens on phone and desktop, readable with JS off; the private link needs Gordon's login, so a PDF and the podcast file go with it.
taught_me_something: Tsathoggua, the toad god of Hyperborea, is named in At the Mountains of Madness, the same story his two tracks come from.
told_me_the_truth: Search does not find him yet, the bass-Lovecraft canon already exists, Lovecraft's racism is named, and budget estimates are labeled as estimates.
weakest: The 3D fandom map gets crowded at phone width; next pass would cluster labels by state.
